annotations.title: Check a published site the way a visitor and a crawler see it

description: For a published domain of your site: https root 200, http and www reach https://<domain>/ in one hop, title/description/og tags name the site, og:image is a 1200x630 PNG/JPEG, the favicon is the site's own, no editor leftovers, outbound links answer, exactly one h1, no draft badge. Returns PASS/WARN/FAIL per check. stored:true returns the automatic report made about two minutes after publish_site.

domain.description: The published domain to check, e.g. "angelamcgraw.com".

name.description: The person or business the title and og tags must name. Defaults to the site name.

stored.description: true = return the newest stored report (including the automatic one ~2 minutes after publish_site) without fetching.

name: live_check
title: Check a published site the way a visitor and a crawler see it
